rt:param.name: Obj_Type_Nr
rt:param.comment: Номер схемы сигналов из конф. файла от 1 до 3

rt:param.name: Is_reg_valve
rt:param.comment: Это регулирующий клапан, а не моментная муфта, для которой положения - МИНИМУМ и МАКСИМУМ

rt:var.name: STrig
rt:var.comment: наш вывод в ремонт - запрет управления

rt:var.name: More_signals
rt:var.comment: Есть ещё сигналы, найденные по маске

rt:var.name: Mask
rt:var.comment: Маска поиска дополнительных сигналов, сконструированная по гибкому правилу с учётом наличия точек

rt:var.name: DV_fill_dir
rt:var.comment: заливка барографа -1 = влево; 0 = от нуля 1 = вправо

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub HighlightMessage(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal pv As PlsPVBin, ByVal mask As UShort, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If (pv == Nothing) || (mask == 0) Then TxtObj.visibility = "hidden" Else TxtObj.visibility = "visible" If pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" TxtObj.text_decoration = "password" ElseIf (pv.Value & mask) != 0 Then TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End If End Sub

Sub HighlightMessageSimple(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal Highlight As Boolean, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If Highlight Then TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End Sub

Sub Open_diag() HighlightMessage(OPEN, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN, 0) If Is_NARY Then HighlightMessage(CLOSED, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSED, 0) HighlightMessage(NOT_OPEN, pv_OPEN, mask_NOT_OPEN, 0) HighlightMessage(NOT_CLOSED, pv_OPEN, mask_NOT_CLOSED, 0) HighlightMessage(INTERMEDIATE, pv_OPEN, mask_INTERMEDIATE, 0) HighlightMessage(OPENING, pv_OPEN, mask_OPENING, 0) HighlightMessage(CLOSING, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSING, 0) HighlightMessage(OPEN_MISMATCH, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_MISMATCH, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(OPEN_OVERTIME, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_OVERTIME, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_OVERTIME, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_OVERTIME, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(OPEN_HI_MOMENT, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_HI_MOMENT, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_HI_MOMENT, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_HI_MOMENT, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL, pv_OPEN, mask_FAIL, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL_BLINK, pv_OPEN, mask_FAIL_BLINK, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(INVALID, pv_OPEN, mask_INVALID, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(UNDEFINED, pv_OPEN, mask_UNDEFINED, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(TEST, pv_OPEN, mask_TEST, Middle_Color_Wieghted(Color_Imitation, 0,0.75)) HighlightMessage(REPAIR, pv_OPEN, mask_REPAIR, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(SELECTED, pv_OPEN, mask_SELECTED, 0) HighlightMessage(A, pv_A, mask_A, 0) HighlightMessage(H, pv_A, mask_H, 0) HighlightMessage(A_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_A_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(H_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_H_MISMATCH, 0xf5) End If End Sub

Sub POSITION_Status() Dim CV_txt As String If pv_POSITION == Nothing Then CV_txt = "---" gr_POSITION_CV_bg.fill = Color_ErLink gr_POSITION_CV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_POSITION_CV_bar.fill = Color_ErLink gr_POSITION_CV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else CV_txt = pv_POSITION.ValueAscii() If (pv_POSITION.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then gr_POSITION_CV_bg.fill = Color_Inval gr_POSITION_CV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_POSITION_CV_bar.fill = Color_Inval Else Dim CVColor As UInt CVColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_POSITION) gr_POSITION_CV_bg.fill = CVColor If CVColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then gr_POSITION_CV_bg.visibility = "hidden" Else gr_POSITION_CV_bg.visibility = "inherit" End If gr_POSITION_CV_bar.fill = CVColor End If Dim fx_val As Double fx_val = (pv_POSITION.Value - pv_POSITION.RangeLow) / (pv_POSITION.RangeHigh - pv_POSITION.RangeLow) If fx_val > 1 Then gr_POSITION_CV_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val < 0 Then gr_POSITION_CV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_POSITION_CV_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If End If gr_POSITION_CV_val.text = CV_txt End Sub

Sub DEVIATION_Status() Dim DV_txt As String Dim fx_val As Double Dim DV_val As Double If pv_DEVIATION == Nothing Then DV_txt = "---" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = Color_ErLink gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = Color_ErLink Else DV_txt = pv_DEVIATION.ValueAscii() DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.Value If (pv_DEVIATION.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = Color_Inval gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = Color_Inval Else Dim DVColor As UInt DVColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_DEVIATION) gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = DVColor If DVColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "hidden" Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" End If gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = DVColor End If
If DV_fill_dir > 0 Then //заливка слева направо fx_val = (DV_val - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If fx_val > 1.0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val < 0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If ElseIf DV_fill_dir < 0 Then //заливка справа налево fx_val = (DV_val - pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh) / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If fx_val < -1.0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val > 0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If Else //заливка от нуля Dim Pos_Zero As Float //абсолютная координата нуля Dim Pos_Val As Float //абсолютная координата столбика Pos_Zero = DV_X - DV_W * pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If DV_val > pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh Then DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh ElseIf DV_val < pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow Then DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow End If If DV_val > 0 Then //заливка положительной области gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Zero gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = DV_W * DV_val / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) ElseIf DV_val < 0 Then //заливка отрицательной области Pos_Val = Pos_Zero + DV_W * DV_val / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Val gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = Pos_Zero - Pos_Val Else //покажем ноль узенькой полоской gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Zero - 1 gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = 2 End If End IF End If gr_DEVIATION_DV_val.text = DV_txt End Sub

Sub SETPOINT_Status() Dim SP_txt As String If pv_SETPOINT == Nothing Then SP_txt = "---" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = Color_ErLink gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = Color_ErLink gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else SP_txt = pv_SETPOINT.ValueAscii() If (pv_SETPOINT.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = Color_Inval gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = Color_Inval Else Dim SPColor As UInt SPColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_SETPOINT) gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = SPColor If SPColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "hidden" Else gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" End If gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = SPColor End If Dim fx_val As Double fx_val = (pv_SETPOINT.Value - pv_SETPOINT.RangeLow) / (pv_SETPOINT.RangeHigh - pv_SETPOINT.RangeLow) If fx_val > 1 Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val < 0 Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If End If gr_SETPOINT_SP_val.text = SP_txt End Sub

TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_AUX_SIGNAL_MASK")) If Left(TmpName, 1) == "." Then 'если первый символ = точка, значит задана маска с точками Mask = PRJSPEC.BuildFinalMask(KKS, TmpName) Else 'иначе - маской является расширение после разделителя Mask = KKS + Delimiter + TmpName End If Dim selBINs(100) As Int Dim selANAs(100) As Int Dim actualANAs As Int Dim actualBINs As Int More_signals = PRJSPEC.GET_Selection(Mask, actualANAs, actualBINs, selANAs, selBINs)
If !Is_reg_valve Then ttl_Closed.text = "МИНИМУМ" ttl_Open.text = "МАКСИМУМ" CLOSED.text = "МИНИМУМ" OPEN.text = "МАКСИМУМ" NOT_CLOSED.text = "НЕ МИНИМУМ" NOT_OPEN.text = "НЕ МАКСИМУМ" CLOSING.text = "ХОД К МИНИМУМУ" OPENING.text = "ХОД К МАКСИМУМУ" End If
